decision: not-adopted; insufficient qualified benefit, not proof of ineffectiveness
limitations: Selected actual workloads only. Phase intervals are inclusive/overlap, not pure root enumeration or hardware pause guarantees. Age bins0/1/2-3/4-7/8+ are sweep epochs of sampled conses only, not ages of all object types. Live age snapshots are process-lifetime samples still present at the case boundary, including earlier-case/startup conses; they are not an isolated retention ratio of the current workload. Allocation counters count conses/floats/vector cells/symbols/string chars/intervals/strings, not bytes. No performance promotion or full compatibility claim; existing quietness policy unchanged.
